next.reason: 1985: 'PAGE [LIMIT IS] integer-1 [LINE] [HEADING integer-2] [FIRST DETAIL integer-3] [LAST DETAIL integer-4] [FOOTING integer-5]'; 2023: 'integer-2 [COLS|COLUMNS] ... LAST {CONTROL HEADING|CH} IS integer-5; If integer-1 is not specified, the report consists of a single page'. RD with IS GLOBAL is kept, but the PAGE clause now accepts more programs: a page width (COLS), LAST CONTROL HEADING, and omission of the page limit integer-1.
